architectureDecisions: PostgreSQL is authoritative; Telegram is a default-disabled adapter, never a task database.
Environment owns bot tokens; DB stores only environment key/identity metadata. No auth cache, cookie or provider token access.
Per-bot poll lease plus transactional update receipts/effects/outbox/offset. No polling alongside a configured webhook; no webhook deletion or public ingress.
Numeric user and chat authority plus route permissions; bots ignored, reply depth 3 and command rate limit. Executor/reviewer role names remain future routing.
Cycle controls serialize on existing agent locks; pause blocks new claims, running task continues, cancel uses current fencing and is terminal after recovery.
Approvals bind fixture cycle/operator/action/chat/bot/expiry/evidence; durable decision precedes outbound success, never dispatches publication.

Event triggers enqueue sanitized persisted ID/type references transactionally. Known rejections retry at most five attempts, ambiguous sends quarantine UNKNOWN without blind replay; no exactly-once guarantee.
Usage commands read existing snapshots/freshness only; Git/FFmpeg fixtures remain quota-independent.
UI shows real backend metadata/errors and validates routing without sending. No frontend token entry.
